notes.title: Deadfall: Released on November 6th!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

I hasten to inform everyone that BekkerDev Studio has returned from a long stasis and is ready to show the world a new game, Deadfall, which will be released on November 6! The game will appeal to all fans of bloody dynamic shooters, fans of old school games and the atmosphere of old action movies of the 80s and 90s, which permeates the entire game.

The development of the game was primarily inspired by the 2004 game Far Cry from the Crytek studio and such films as Terminator, Rambo, Commando, Predator and others. The game also contains a lot of humor and references. The soundtrack is written in the Metal genre with notes of Industrial, Synthwave and also has a clear spirit of the Terminator.

Deadfall tells us the story of the valiant B4 squad under the command of Colonel Paul Greenberg. We will play as Sergeant Roach Craig, a combat veteran who has mastery of weapons, his body and knows how to control pain. She and Pole are longtime friends who have gone through thick and thin together. On Rockford Island, in laboratories, scientists led by Ben Broadbury are developing a drug that makes a person faster, stronger and more resilient. The colonel gave the order to obtain data on experiments and research, so he sent agent Alex Byrne to the island. Soon he stopped communicating, then the colonel sends a group from detachment B4 to the island to find out what happened. The truth will be terrifying...

In the game you will find long levels, dizzying and epic shootouts, a bunch of weapons, land and water transport (even a tank!), a dynamic narrative, various events and plot twists, chases and battles on vehicles, a squad management system and team combat, two difficulty modes “Recruit” and “Veteran”, and... paradisiacal tropical islands infested with creatures.

Meet Deadfall on November 6th and add the game to your wishlist! Rise and shine, BekkerDev Studio, your hour has struck again!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448420/Deadfall/

notes.title: Deadfall is a bloody shooter in the spirit of action movies of the 80s and 90s
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, dear friends! Almost 2 years after the last release, I'm ready to present you my new project called Deadfall. This is going to be a bloody fast paced walkthrough shooter inspired by action movies from the 80s and 90s and Far Cry from 2004. You have to play as the brave Sergeant Roach Craig and go to Rockford Island, where a long and dangerous adventure awaits you! More details can be found on the game page.

notes.title: Deep Despair 2 is now available!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1686130/Deep_Despair_2

Hello everyone!

The second part of Deep Despair has been released today! The sequel will be able to please you with a wide variety of content, refined mechanics, as well as a host of innovations, thanks to which dozens of hours of gameplay await you. The game combines many genres and mechanics: sandboxing, building, crafting, farming, animal husbandry, exploration, mining, cooking, brewing, battles, boss fights, electricity system, full terraforming, and more. Therefore, everyone will find in it what they like.

I am an indie developer working on a game alone. For me, game development has always been a favorite hobby and I spend most of my life behind it. First of all, I do this on enthusiasm without regard to financial aspects, but I will be very pleased if you support my work. So I will have the opportunity to continue to delight you with updates to Deep Despair 2, new games and do what you love without thinking about survival issues. Your support is very motivating to develop and get better, because without it the second part would not have come out.

I wish you all a pleasant time in Deep Despair 2! If you find bugs or have any questions, wishes and ideas - feel free to share it in reviews and discussions.

[b]I would also like to warn you that the saves of the game of different versions may be incompatible.[/b] Since the architecture of the project changes with each major innovation, it is not always possible to implement compatibility. In this regard, players may lose the opportunity to continue the game in the new version on the old save. I solved this problem by splitting the game assemblies into branches:
The main branch will have the latest stable version of the game.
The Latest Build branch will contain the latest version of the game, which may contain bugs and errors. This thread is mainly intended for testing the game and those who want to be the first to try out new content.
The Update 1.x branches will have stable builds of each of the major updates.

Therefore, you can always play on any version of the game and you will have the opportunity to continue playing on the old version so as not to lose your save.

[b]To switch a branch, you need to go to the properties of Deep Despair 2 (RMB on the game -> Properties), then go to the "Beta versions" tab and select the branch you need from the list.[/b]

notes.title: Deep Despair 2 Live Stream!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The second broadcast will begin very soon, in which we will continue to play Deep Despair 2 and look at the rest of the content that we did not have time to watch on the first broadcast.
There is a lot in the game, and even after the next trip to the mine it can take about an hour until you lay out all the resources, make new tools, check the farm with the harvest, prepare food, feed the animals or brew new potions. The game is too addictive, so I got to the first boss in the last stream in 8 hours. This time we will look at all the remaining types of armor, farm the jungle, go to the swamps, and also go to the bowels, where we will get the best equipment in the game at the moment!

Enjoy your viewing in advance! I would be glad to see your comments and ideas regarding the game itself. Together we can make the game better!

notes.title: Demo is available now!
notes.notes:
Good day, dear players!

I hasten to inform you that the demo is already available for download! Now you can familiarize yourself with the game before purchasing. Here is a list of differences from the full version of the game:
[list][*] There are no dungeons, and only the surface is available for research
[*]Missing in-game map and minimap
[*]There is no water transport
[*]There are no boss battles
[*]Some game mechanics have been cut
[*] Removed the generation of cultures around the world
[*] The cycle of day and night is removed, only daytime is available
[*] Limited character development and crafting
[*] Only the smallest world is available for creation
[/ list]

Let me remind you that the game will also participate in the upcoming festival, which will be held from October 1 to October 7. 

[b]The game will be released on October 8![/b]
